name: 48855 · Howell, MI
findings: ZIP 48855 (Howell) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48855 (Howell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
